'''Ullumub''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Dromo]]. When her master was attacked by a [[Shenbit bonecrusher]] during a safari on [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]], she offered a reward to those who rescued him from the predator, with extra reward if they could also save her master's favorite [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]].<ref name="GatORW" />
